title: 1.5x speed-up next to the original
caption: The talking-head edit sped up 1.5x with pitch-preserved audio, playing next to the original from the same start frame: after 8 s the fast copy has covered 12 s of the edit, so its captions and the playhead run ahead. The sound is the sped-up track.
prompt: Speed up 12 seconds of ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 (from 2 s) by 1.5x with pitch-preserved audio, so it plays in 8 s. To show the client the difference, put the first 8 s of the original and the sped-up clip side by side on a dark brown frame, each with a small Geist label (labels.svg, fonts/), and use the sped-up audio.
commands: ffmpeg -t 8 -i work/source.mp4 -i work/fast.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "color=c=0x2b1c17:s=1920x1080:r=30:d=8[bg];[0:v]scale=912:513,setsar=1[l];[1:v]scale=912:513,setsar=1[r];[bg][l]overlay=32:300[a];[a][r]overlay=976:300[b];[b][2:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 1:a -t 8 -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/compare.mp4
